implementation_tests.disclosed_caveat: Every synthetic world carries a clinical signal, so a model can clear a mean-relative bar through the clinical branch alone. The mean-relative number is not by itself evidence about the EEG pathway. The reduction against a clinical-only ridge baseline is reported per row and per check as a diagnostic; the plan's criterion was implemented as written and not substituted.

interpretation_guard: Record-level EEG models are clearly worse than the clinical baselines on both targets; learning order carries no advantage; M2 switched the EEG block off in every fold. The M3-vs-M4 comparison is clean (identical budget); the M3/M4-vs-M0/M1 comparison confounds a 400-step Adam joint fit with a closed-form ridge solution and must not be read as 'EEG carries no information'.
known_delivery_gap: Per-fit optimiser diagnostics required by plan 8.2 (final loss, gradient, training error, numerical failure) were not persisted. Prediction ranges were recovered from saved predictions; the rest cannot be recovered without refitting, which the plan forbids for reporting repairs.
